resolution: The original generation-2 RunDescriptor binding remained vulnerable to benchmark-generation self-attestation and run/SUT co-forging with a freshly compatible descriptor. PR497 adds a separate evaluator-created BenchmarkRunAdmission that is constructed without a PredictionCandidate, seals benchmark generation + exact RunDescriptor digest + run/SUT + fixture identity, and requires a separately supplied retained expected admission digest before scoring. Exact PR-head and merged-main repository-hosted prediction and admission CI all passed. The old reconciliation remains historical evidence for its narrower earlier scope; this successor reconciliation supersedes it only for the current generation-2 status projection. Runtime/VPS/physical GRID10/GWT/J-Space/provider/training/effect/completion/world-truth/whole-system credit remains zero.
remaining_open_boundary: The next higher-scope integration must prove an outer evaluator/run harness pins the expected admission digest before candidate emission. This successor acceptance does not claim that integration/runtime fact.
next_exact_action: Keep WP803 generation 2 closed at repository-component scope. Do not rewrite hot aggregate STATE/WORKPACKAGES. Re-enter current main and advance the smallest nonduplicate Stage-8 integration frontier. If WP803 is raised again, require an exact new falsifier or an explicit higher-scope run-harness/manifest integration claim before mutation.
